extraction.policy_summary: JSW Steel states it 'has adopted policies that promote equal opportunity, diversity, inclusion, non-discrimination, and respect for human rights, including provisions aligned with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016,' and that these policies collectively ensure non-discriminatory employment practices, equal opportunity, accessibility, and availability of grievance redressal mechanisms for all employees and workers, including persons with disabilities.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: As at end of FY 2025-26, the company reports 29 total differently abled employees (25 male, 86.21%; 4 female, 13.79%), all under Permanent (Other than Permanent = 0), and 0 total differently abled workers (Permanent = 0, Other than Permanent = 0).
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: The company answers 'Yes' that premises/offices are accessible to differently abled employees and workers, stating: 'The Company's offices and operational locations, wherever differently abled employees and workers are present, are equipped with appropriate accessibility infrastructure and facilities in line with the requirements of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, to enable safe and inclusive access to the workplace.' Separately confirms premises are accessible to differently abled visitors. No specific physical features (ramps, restrooms, elevators) are itemized.
extraction.compliance_details: The company affirmatively answers the mandated BRSR statutory questions: premises/offices accessible to differently abled employees and workers per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 ('Yes'); an equal opportunity policy in place with provisions aligned to the RPwD Act, 2016; and premises accessible to differently abled visitors per the RPwD Act, 2016 ('Yes').

evidence.quote: The Company has adopted policies that promote equal opportunity, diversity, inclusion, non-discrimination, and respect for human rights, including provisions aligned with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016

The Company's offices and operational locations, wherever differently abled employees and workers are present, are equipped with appropriate accessibility infrastructure and facilities in line with the requirements of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
Yes, The Company's premises and offices are accessible to differently abled visitors, in line with the requirements of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
